comments:
a0c81b31: 
 .;
Death Geospatial Injury Output 
 .;Primary routine controlling the sort and output parameters for DGJOTP
 .;This allows the user to choose how to sort the data and which data to
 .;output - patient lists versus totals page versus both.
6abfb045: If no response, set default to PHYSICIAN sort
87e3a53e: Set the sort type based on the user's response
4d0f870f: If user enters '?' display sort help
e3d4c481: If invalid response, display sort help
6a5ea50c: If no response, set default to BOTH inpatients and outpatients
e01e3160: Set the patient type based on the user's response
84012688: If user enters '?' display patient type help
5e139787: If invalid response, display patient type help
db861a50: If no response, set default to BOTH patient lists and totals page
df1f05e1: Set the output type based on the user's response
5eba706a: If user enters '?' display output type help
0ca9ea59: If invalid response, display output type help
05a03bed: If Discharge Global entry exists, set DGJTMUL to the multiplier value
ed72bd9c: Set the DGJTL flag based on the sort type
751eeb25: Set the DGJTSTAT variable to the internal entry numbers for the different status values
0bf64d26: Branch to DGJOTP1 to continue processing
c6821aae: Kill (clear) all implicated variables in the main routine
bedd6edf: Kill additional implicated variables
a4af4432: Kill more variables
06ba01b7: Kill even more variables
37969961: Kill the remaining variables, including FileMan utility variables
6af36576: Close the FileMan utility queue and quit

47f33b8e: 
 .;
Date selection for output
 .;This allows the user to specify a date range for the output
337bb432: Prompt the user for the start date and set DGJTBG and DGJTBEG
90f020ac: Prompt the user for the end date
c051315f: Set the DGJTEND variable to the end date plus .9999 (to include the entire day)
bd586688: Error check - make sure the end date is not before the start date
7ec9cfd8: Quit the date selection logic
aac81051: Display the help text for the sort type selection prompt
8e70e896: Quit the sort type help
27f8780b: Display the help text for the patient type selection prompt
c6da2695: Quit the patient type help
81ccbc52: Display the help text for the output type selection prompt
f141bd5b: Quit the output type help
cbc4961b: Set the sort type prompt text
3e7ad969: Set the patient type prompt text
6e70280e: Set the output type prompt text
